content.label: Daily aggregate click counts per link (UTC), no personal data (recommended)

acceptance_criteria.text: GET /api/v1/links/{code}/stats/daily with a valid API key returns 200 with the redirect count per UTC day.
Each successful redirect increments exactly one daily bucket, so the endpoint returns exact counts.
A request without a valid API key returns 401; an unknown code returns 404.
The daily table stores only the code, the UTC day and the count; existing stats responses are unchanged.

constraints: No personal data is stored or returned (FR-SHR-012).
